t: A fully open FPGA board with Wi-Fi, video, audio, and plenty of memory.
steps: Buy the ULX3S from Crowd Supply or Mouser. The 12F version is about 145 US dollars.
Get a micro USB cable and use the port marked for the FTDI programmer.
Install OSS-CAD-Suite, which bundles Yosys, nextpnr-ecp5, Project Trellis, and openFPGALoader.
Read the board manual in the emard/ulx3s repo.
Build an LED blink example and upload it with openFPGALoader or fujprog.
Connect a monitor to the video port and try a video example from the ulx3s-misc repo.
Try the FPGArduino project to code a soft processor from the Arduino IDE.
meta: Wild Open. From $145. A few stores.
